title: Flower prices go up in Bohol ahead of Undas

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — Flower prices in Tagbilaran City, Bohol, have increased by around P10 to P30 ahead of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, or Undas, prompting vendors to offer bundled arrangements as more affordable options for customers. A bundle that previously cost P75 now sells for P100, while a P100 bundle has increased to P200. Arrangements previously priced at P300 now cost P500 and include assorted flowers in different colors and a container. Chrysanthemums, Malaysian mums, roses and anthuriums remain among the most popular choices among buyers. Evelyn Estomata, 46, said the flowers were sourced from Cebu, Manila […]...
